activities.title: Saint-Pierre en fête returns to Lachine on September 19
activities.description: The free neighbourhood celebration includes family activities, music and a community breakfast, with events centred on Parc Kirkland.

activities.title: Anjou plans more than 200 large trees in September planting campaign
activities.description: Public spaces, park edges and a pedestrian passage are among the locations identified by the borough.

activities.title: Bank of Canada holds policy rate at 2.25% in September decision
activities.description: The central bank cites inflation risks and trade uncertainty; its next scheduled decision is October 28.

activities.title: Dorval transit hub moves into planning, with construction expected in 2027
activities.description: The proposed hub would bring VIA Rail, exo and airport shuttle connections together near Dorval Terminal.

activities.title: Pointe-Claire council to consider stormwater-aid changes on September 8
activities.description: The agenda also lists heritage assistance and infrastructure proposals; these are scheduled items, not confirmed decisions.

activities.title: Canada opens search for next Canada Post CEO as Doug Ettinger plans retirement
activities.description: The current chief executive’s term ends March 3, 2027, and applications for the role close October 6.

activities.title: Montréal details UCI road-race closures and towing dates
activities.description: Updated city guidance outlines restrictions in Old Montréal, Centre-Sud and Peter-McGill during the September championships.

activities.title: West Island Pride returns to Pointe-Claire on September 12
activities.description: The community event at Edgewater Park runs from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. with a story time, panel, variety show and award ceremony.

activities.title: Kirkland completes Timberlea repair without water shutdown
activities.description: Kirkland says Friday’s Timberlea water repair was completed without interrupting service, so no new boil-water advisory is required.

activities.title: Ottawa directs $275,000 to three September sport events in Québec
activities.description: Federal sport-hosting grants include $150,000 for the Grands Prix Cyclistes de Québec et de Montréal and support for events in Gatineau and Québec City.

activities.title: Québec’s new ticket-resale and subscription rules take effect
activities.description: New Québec consumer rules require clearer ticket-resale information, easier online cancellation and advance notice when temporary subscription discounts expire.

activities.title: Ottawa adds $112 million to national sport funding and schedules November summit
activities.description: A new $112-million federal allocation includes an Alpine Canada top-up, while sport-sector representatives are due to meet in Ottawa November 9 and 10.

activities.title: Two Ottawa–Gatineau crossings face daytime closures next week
activities.description: Motorists face daytime closures at the Alexandra Bridge and the Gatineau approach to the Chaudière Crossing between September 14 and 18.

activities.title: Québec parliament publishes free autumn programme through December
activities.description: Exhibitions, family events, literary activities and guided experiences are included in the National Assembly’s new autumn visitor programme.

activities.title: Transportation
activities.description:
Public transit will run on reduced schedules Monday. 
STM buses and the métro on a holiday schedule.



RTL (Longueuil) and STL (Laval) buses on Sunday schedules.



Exo buses on a Saturday schedule.



Exo commuter trains on Sunday schedules. There will be no service on the Mont-St-Hilaire, Candiac or Masouche lines.



The REM will maintain its regular hours of operation but run on a schedule of non-rush-hour frequency.
 The City of Montreal says all parking restrictions will remain in effect.
